_rule: The number may RISE, never fall. A spec reporting fewer checks than this fails — that is the guard against an early return, a swallowed locator error, or a deleted assertion, all of which are green without it. Regenerate on a green suite with `npm run test:browser:record`, and say in the commit why a number went down.
_: How many checks each browser spec must report. See tests/support/expected-checks.mjs.
_participants-groups-membership: 13 -> 12 for EZ-1780. The spec tested a mixed active+Moodle-pending selection, which needed a course that is unlinked *and* still holds pending invitations — a state reachable only because unlinking deleted nothing, which was the bug. Unlink now deletes them and changeset 210826-5 clears the leftovers, so the mixed assertions were removed rather than rewritten: fakeApi can build the payload, but not make it mean anything. Two of the four removed checks were replaced by a single-row chip removal, which is reachable and was not covered.
